# Since the schema does not mention namespace column, we assume all data belongs to this namespace

# Separate metric types by presence of columns and known patterns
# App metrics have columns: serviceName, startTime, avg_time, num, succee_num, succee_rate
app_metrics_cols = {'serviceName', 'startTime', 'avg_time', 'num', 'succee_num', 'succee_rate'}
is_app_metric = set(metric_df.columns).issuperset(app_metrics_cols)

if is_app_metric:
    app_metric_df = metric_df[metric_df.columns.intersection(app_metrics_cols)]
else:
    app_metric_df = pd.DataFrame()

# Other metrics have columns: itemid, name, bomc_id, timestamp, value, cmdb_id
# We can distinguish container, node, and service metrics by cmdb_id prefix
if not is_app_metric:
    # Extract container metrics: cmdb_id starts with 'docker_'
    container_metric_df = metric_df[metric_df['cmdb_id'].str.startswith('docker_', na=False)] if 'cmdb_id' in metric_df.columns else pd.DataFrame()
    # Extract node metrics: cmdb_id starts with 'os_'
    node_metric_df = metric_df[metric_df['cmdb_id'].str.startswith('os_', na=False)] if 'cmdb_id' in metric_df.columns else pd.DataFrame()
    # Extract service metrics: cmdb_id starts with 'db_'
    service_metric_df = metric_df[metric_df['cmdb_id'].str.startswith('db_', na=False)] if 'cmdb_id' in metric_df.columns else pd.DataFrame()
else:
    container_metric_df = pd.DataFrame()
    node_metric_df = pd.DataFrame()
    service_metric_df = pd.DataFrame()

# Extract unique KPIs (names) for each metric type
# For app metrics, KPIs are fixed columns except serviceName and startTime
app_kpis = []
if not app_metric_df.empty:
    app_kpis = [col for col in app_metric_df.columns if col not in ['serviceName', 'startTime']]

container_kpis = container_metric_df['name'].unique() if not container_metric_df.empty else []
node_kpis = node_metric_df['name'].unique() if not node_metric_df.empty else []
service_kpis = service_metric_df['name'].unique() if not service_metric_df.empty else []

# Extract unique root cause components for nodes, containers, and services

container_components = container_metric_df['cmdb_id'].unique() if not container_metric_df.empty else []
service_components = service_metric_df['cmdb_id'].unique() if not service_metric_df.empty else []

# Prepare results as DataFrames for better display

kpi_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'Metric_Type': ['App']*len(app_kpis) + ['Container']*len(container_kpis) + ['Node']*len(node_kpis) + ['Service']*len(service_kpis),
    'KPI_Name': list(app_kpis) + list(container_kpis) + list(node_kpis) + list(service_kpis)
})

components_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'Component_Type': ['Node']*len(node_components) + ['Container']*len(container_components) + ['Service']*len(service_components),
    'Component_ID': list(node_components) + list(container_components) + list(service_components)
})

import pytz

# Reuse metric_df loaded previously, which contains App metrics only
# Confirm it has the expected columns for App metrics
app_metric_cols = {'serviceName', 'startTime', 'avg_time', 'num', 'succee_num', 'succee_rate'}
if not app_metric_cols.issubset(metric_df.columns):
    app_metric_df = pd.DataFrame()
else:
    app_metric_df = metric_df[list(app_metric_cols)].copy()

# Convert startTime to datetime with UTC+8 timezone
tz = pytz.timezone('Asia/Shanghai')
app_metric_df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(app_metric_df['startTime'], unit='s').dt.tz_localize('UTC').dt.tz_convert(tz)

# Calculate global thresholds per serviceName and KPI over entire time range
# KPIs: avg_time (P95), succee_rate (P5), num and succee_num are counts, thresholds not meaningful for anomaly detection here
thresholds = []

for service in app_metric_df['serviceName'].unique():
    service_data = app_metric_df[app_metric_df['serviceName'] == service]
    # Calculate P95 for avg_time
    p95_avg_time = service_data['avg_time'].quantile(0.95)
    # Calculate P5 for succee_rate
    p5_succee_rate = service_data['succee_rate'].quantile(0.05)
    thresholds.append({
        'serviceName': service,
        'avg_time_p95': p95_avg_time,
        'succee_rate_p5': p5_succee_rate
    })

thresholds_df = pd.DataFrame(thresholds)

# Define failure time window in UTC+8
start_time = tz.localize(pd.Timestamp('2020-04-11 00:00:00'))
end_time = tz.localize(pd.Timestamp('2020-04-11 00:30:00'))

# Filter app metrics to failure time window
app_metric_window = app_metric_df[(app_metric_df['datetime'] >= start_time) & (app_metric_df['datetime'] <= end_time)]

# Identify anomalies:
# avg_time > P95 threshold
# succee_rate < P5 threshold
anomalies = []

for _, row in app_metric_window.iterrows():
    service = row['serviceName']
    threshold_row = thresholds_df[thresholds_df['serviceName'] == service]
    if threshold_row.empty:
        continue
    p95_avg_time = threshold_row['avg_time_p95'].values[0]
    p5_succee_rate = threshold_row['succee_rate_p5'].values[0]

    if row['avg_time'] > p95_avg_time:
        anomalies.append({
            'serviceName': service,
            'KPI': 'avg_time',
            'timestamp': row['datetime'],
            'value': row['avg_time']
        })
    if row['succee_rate'] < p5_succee_rate:
        anomalies.append({
            'serviceName': service,
            'KPI': 'succee_rate',
            'timestamp': row['datetime'],
            'value': row['succee_rate']
        })

anomalies_df = pd.DataFrame(anomalies)

# Display thresholds and anomalies
thresholds_df, anomalies_df
